claim: GIBO (Müller, von Rohr, Trimpe, NeurIPS 2021) is the algorithm Fan et al.'s MinUCB directly modifies, and GIBO's own local-search step is gradient descent using the GP posterior-mean gradient estimate -- not a UCB or LCB acquisition of any kind. GIBO is therefore the true prior-work origin of the 'local search via GP-based two-stage loop' framework, predating Fan et al. by three years.
stance_target: Correct attribution: the general local-BO-via-GP-acquisition premise traces to GIBO (2021), not to fan2024minucb (2024), which only substitutes GIBO's exploitation objective
scope_conditions: Local Bayesian optimization / local policy search, NeurIPS 2021, arXiv:2106.11899
quoted_support: "Our proposed method delegates the exploitation to a gradient-based optimizer after exploring a local property, the function's derivative at the current iterate, for which a local search (and model) is sufficient." (Introduction, line 219-221)

stance_target: Whether GIBO is a plausible alternative true-owner citation for the LCB-paralysis mechanism
